Update policy section data for all policies or a set of specified policy_key  values.
Requires "Grant resource - Write" API permission.
Note: This API call uses the PUT request method, which must be represented as JSON
and cannot be passed in via URL parameters. Some Duo clients (Python or Java, for
example) offer helper functions to handle requests to the Admin API.
